name: wugweb/cookie-consent
title: Cookie consent
description: First-visit cookie banner and preferences modal (BaseLayout port). Remembers the choice in localStorage wugweb_cookie_consent_v1; gates analytics on consent.

subtitle.default: We use necessary cookies to operate Wugweb and optional cookies to understand how our website is used and improve your experience.

default.title: Strictly Necessary
default.text: Required for core website functionality, security, consent management and other essential functions.

default.title: Functional
default.text: Helps remember preferences and provide enhanced functionality.

default.title: Analytics
default.text: Helps us understand how visitors use Wugweb and improve website performance and experience.
